# Getting Help with dyadMLM

Questions and contributions are welcome.

- For help using the package, specifying a model, or interpreting output, use
  [Q&A Discussions](https://github.com/Pascal-Kueng/dyadMLM/discussions/categories/q-a).
- For open-ended feature or method ideas, use
  [Ideas](https://github.com/Pascal-Kueng/dyadMLM/discussions/categories/ideas).
- If something seems broken or you have a concrete improvement in mind, open an
  [Issue](https://github.com/Pascal-Kueng/dyadMLM/issues/new/choose).

If you are unsure, choose whichever place seems closest. We can sort it out
together.

A small reproducible example, package and model-engine versions, and
`sessionInfo()` are especially helpful when something is not working.

Please only share data you are permitted to make public. Never upload
identifiable or confidential research data.
